summary.short: Appropriates $300,000 (FY2024) and $500,000 (FY2025) of Washington's general fund-state, provided solely for the city of Seattle to lease space for nonprofit and academic institutions that incubate AI-focused technology startups and to develop and teach AI workforce curricula.
summary.long: This partial text, subsection (50) of Senate Bill 5950, makes appropriations of $300,000 of the general fund-state for fiscal year 2024 and $500,000 for fiscal year 2025. The funds are provided solely for the city of Seattle to lease space for nonprofit and academic institutions to incubate technology business startups, especially those focusing on artificial intelligence. The same provision states that the funds are also to develop and teach curricula that skill up workers to use artificial intelligence as a business resource. The excerpt contains no other operative provisions, no eligibility criteria, selection procedures, reporting duties or enforcement terms.
